title: I released 184 free detail pixel-art buildings, from rural huts to city landmarks, each with 8 angles and most with a winter version
author: Ill_Insurance6598
selftext:
I've been building a free pack of pixel-art buildings for indie games, and the first batch is out.

What's in it:

* 184 different buildings (more to come): cottages, barns, workshops, inns, town houses, civic buildings, apartments and landmarks
* 8 viewing angles each, on a 30-degree camera
* Winter versions for 168 of them, with snow, icicles and lit windows 
* One folder per building, with PNG sheets and simple JSON (frame rectangles and a ground anchor)
* CC0, so you can use them in anything, commercial included, with no credit needed

More are coming: harbours, castles, railways, a circus and others, aiming for 500. Which kinds of building would be most useful for your game?



Browse them: [https://hoanglong256.github.io/pixel-buildings/](https://hoanglong256.github.io/pixel-buildings/)

Download: [https://github.com/HoangLong256/pixel-buildings](https://github.com/HoangLong256/pixel-buildings)
